description: flange with bore and bolt circle
prompt: Create a flange named `flange`: a disc of 160 mm diameter and 20 mm thickness, centered on the Z axis with its bottom face at z=0. It has a central bore of 60 mm diameter and 6 through holes of 14 mm diameter, equally spaced on a bolt circle of 120 mm diameter.
solution:
hole = Cylinder(60*EX-EZ, ax 22*EZ, 14);
flange: Cylinder(O, ax 20*EZ, 160, 60) - CircularPattern(hole, O, 2*M_PI/6*EZ, 6);
